query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'conversation_id',s.conversation_id,'ordinal',s.ordinal,'revision',s.revision,'state',s.state,'text_only',s.text_only,'summary',s.summary,'provenance',CASE WHEN s.state='final' THEN 'final' ELSE 'provisional' END) AS "data!" FROM assistant_conversation_sources s WHERE s.workspace_id=$1 AND s.conversation_id=$2 AND ($3::bigint IS NULL OR s.ordinal<$3) ORDER BY s.ordinal DESC LIMIT $4
